source.ref: https://github.com/microsoft/typescript-go/pull/1446; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 157, 158, 160, 161, 162, 164, 165, 166, forbid seeds 1612-1615; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A; the merged pull request (6d19ac2df96) added the existence check and committed manualTests.txt, made both scripts use the base test name, and added a usage message

rationale: A manual-tests list for the fourslash conversion scripts (first commit of the pull request; base is the merge base). ADR-0036, vetted blind. row-157 is required: manualTests.txt is neither in the tree nor un-ignored (*.txt is ignored), so convertfourslash and updatefailing throw after deleting tests/gen; upstream fixed it before merging (author-fix). row-160 is required: makemanual can only succeed with the generated file name, which never equals the capitalised name convertfourslash looks up, so the skip list is inert; upstream made both sides use the base name before merging (author-fix; first stated by a model's reference, so producer GLM-4.7). row-158 is dropped as the same root cause stated hypothetically. row-164 is optional: true and fixed upstream, but a missing usage message is outside the correctness contract. row-161 (an empty file name), row-165 (path traversal through the developer's own command-line argument) and row-166 (no _test.go check on a file the developer names) are dropped as speculative or without a trust boundary. row-162 is false (generateGoTest always returns a non-empty template) and, with seeds 1613 and 1614 (an empty string skipping a test, a missing brace), becomes the one forbid range. Seed 1612 is true (manualOutputDir is unused, and upstream removed it) and seed 1615 is a naming opinion contradicted by the sibling script names, so neither is a forbid range.

expect.concern: getManualTests reads manualTests.txt unconditionally although the file is not in the repository and *.txt is git-ignored, so on any checkout where makemanual has not run, convertfourslash (and updatefailing) throws ENOENT after main has already deleted tests/gen, leaving the generated tests removed and none regenerated.

makemanual records the generated file name it is given (such as foo_test.go) in manualTests.txt, while convertfourslash looks up the capitalised base name (Foo), so the skip never matches and the next conversion regenerates every test moved to tests/manual back into tests/gen.
Called without arguments, makemanual exits with status 1 and prints nothing, so the user is not told that it needs the name of a generated test.

forbid.reason: generateGoTest always returns a non-empty Go source template and this block's braces balance, so the guard neither skips a real test, nor lets a whitespace-only file through, nor leaves a syntax error.
